The Question Blocks of the Route Analysis

Source: R/route_analysis.R
ck_route_blocks.Rd

The exact 4Mi question names behind each route block. One row of slots per repeat of the block; follow_ups name the select_multiple questions asked about each slot, and respondent_follow_ups the select_multiple questions asked once per respondent about the route as a whole. sheet is the name of the results sheet the block is written to.

Usage

ck_route_blocks()

Value

A named list, one element per block, in the order the blocks are written: transit_country, places_stop, dangerous_location.
